classes.purpose: Let the model interpret and navigate the exact authorized post-login web process from targeted control and state metadata while authoring or replaying a process-specific capability
classes.content: Target-site origin and query-free path; selected control roles, accessible names, labels and placeholders; headings outside tables and grids; generic visible state markers; declared runtime input values needed for the process; action outcomes; branches; and generic download-event metadata. The default live route does not request full authenticated-page snapshots, table or grid rows, form values, message or invoice content, screenshots, network bodies, account identifiers, credentials, one-time codes, cookies, tokens, browser storage, session URLs, or reusable login state. If one specific private data class or screenshot is genuinely necessary, the workflow identifies that exact data and purpose and requires separate operator confirmation before reading it

classes.purpose: Review, validate, run, or hand off a process-specific capability without transferring the discovery account or browser session
classes.content: Capability identity and version, target site and allowed origins, process objective and exclusions, declared input references without observed values, semantic milestones, locator candidates, side-effect classifications, postconditions, recovery instructions, environment-scoped validation receipts, known limits, and deterministic hashes. Portable bundles exclude credentials, cookies, browser storage, session URLs, page HTML, screenshots, network bodies, downloaded business files, discovery records, observed private values, and account identifiers

external_boundaries.destination: The authorized operator's existing Google Chrome profile and the explicitly bounded website origins connected through the ChatGPT Chrome extension
external_boundaries.purpose: Discover or replay one authorized browser process with model-led interpretation and Playwright actions while preserving operator-owned authentication
external_boundaries.content: The workflow opens a fresh task tab in the connected Chrome profile unless the operator explicitly identifies an existing tab. The selected Codex model receives targeted control and generic state metadata, the target origin and query-free path, declared process inputs, transition outcomes, branches, and generic download-event metadata. Playwright actions send the declared navigation, filters, values, and other authorized interactions to the target website in the ordinary browser session. Authentication and profile or workspace selection remain with the operator. Full authenticated-page snapshots, business rows, message or invoice content, screenshots, network bodies, browser state, credentials, and downloaded business bytes are excluded by default and never placed in the portable capability
controls: Use the live boundary only when the operator explicitly requests discovery or execution on an authorized site, account, and process; bind the run to declared origins, start state, end state, inputs, outputs, and side effects.

Use the installed Chrome control skill and the existing extension profile. Create a fresh task tab unless the operator explicitly identifies one existing tab; never enumerate unrelated tabs or launch a standalone Playwright browser, temporary profile, alternate browser controller, or repeated visibility probe.

Authentication and account, taxpayer, company, or workspace selection belong to the operator. Vera never asks for, inspects, types, stores, or transfers a username when used for secret entry, password, PIN, one-time code, SPID/CIE/CNS material, QR code, cookie, token, browser storage, session URL, or reusable login state.

Query only targeted control roles, accessible names, labels, placeholders, headings outside tables or grids, query-free paths, and generic state markers by default. If one specific private data class or screenshot is necessary, identify the exact data and purpose and require separate operator confirmation before reading it.

Confirm at action time immediately before submitting, sending, signing, paying, publishing, deleting, changing access, uploading private data, or another material external side effect; ordinary read-only and reversible exploration does not require repeated confirmation.
Use Computer Use only for a genuine operating-system or non-browser gap. It must not replace the Chrome extension or Playwright as the browser controller.

Write sanitized discovery records and sealed handoff bundles only to fresh owner-only local directories outside the Git workspace and published folders; never persist raw page content or overwrite an earlier bundle.

Send only the sealed capability folder. The receiving operator authenticates in their own Chrome and validates locally; no browser state, discovery evidence, observed private value, account identifier, or downloaded business file travels with the capability.

security_controls.control: The workflow binds to the existing Chrome extension profile, creates a fresh task tab by default, uses the model for semantic page and branch interpretation, uses Playwright for bounded actions and assertions, and reserves Computer Use for non-browser gaps. A connected Chrome binding replaces the old launcher and visibility ritual; unavailable Chrome produces one setup instruction rather than repeated launch attempts.

Authenticated discovery queries targeted control and generic state metadata rather than full page snapshots, table or grid rows, form values, message or invoice content, or screenshots. Reading one necessary private data class or screenshot requires a separate exact disclosure and operator confirmation.

The standard-library validator rejects forbidden secret and capture fields, email-address literals, unbounded or query-bearing origins, missing semantic locators, consequential actions without action-time confirmation, private-evidence retention, and portable bundles that claim to contain discovery evidence. Sealing is deterministic, owner-only, and non-overwriting.

A capability may claim validated_local only with two complete passed runs from the declared start state, no locator edits during either run, all milestones completed, and no private evidence retained. The status is explicitly environment-specific and the receiving operator must validate again.

The Agenzia and TeamSystem source packages remain scaffold until authorized live discovery supplies actual controls, branches, postconditions and clean replay evidence. Brand or process names alone cannot be described as executable support.
